prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a small old hill village of farmers and storytellers. thick golden-brown straw thatch roof cream plaster walls with dark timber framing and a stone plinth. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 208 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout guide into ONE premium hi-bit pixel-art JRPG hill-village one-storey farmhouse sprite, preserving the supplied guide EXACTLY as a positional stencil. Canvas 208 x 224 ART pixels, with each crisp square art pixel presented as 7x7 screen pixels (1456 x 1568 overall). Preserve the complete original outer building silhouette, its horizontal roof-to-front-wall boundary, ALL three guide windows at precisely their given coordinates and sizes, and the guide's dark brown ground-level door at exactly its original coordinates and dimensions if present in the source image; never move, resize, conceal, or replace these functional openings. The large UPPER golden-brown rectangular block is the roof SEEN FROM ABOVE, a broad thick golden-brown straw thatch surface with deliberate layered bundles and clean blocky pixel clusters; keep its rectangular perimeter. The LOWER front-facing section is straight-on cream plaster with worn dark timber framing and stone plinth, subordinate to roof. Three visible warm amber small-pane windows match the guide's yellow rectangles perfectly, framing and mullions fit within/around those rectangles. Add small flower boxes below some windows without obscuring windows. A real dark brown walk-through door stays grounded and exactly where guide shows it. Optional small chimney into top empty margin. No diagonally pitched roof, no added side wall, no ground, no people, no letters. Outside building completely transparent alpha; magenta means TRANSPARENT, do NOT render magenta. Lighting neutral soft even overcast evening, highlights warm yellow, shadows saturated reddish-purple, 4–6 colors per material, earthy and lived-in. Only windows glow internally: no pools of light, cast shadows, darkness or vignette. Pixel-perfect manually arranged opaque flat-color 3–10-art-pixel clusters, uniformly sized hard square pixels, no antialias, gradients, blurring, airbrush, photographic texture, noise or checkerboard dithering.
